headline: MIN @ DET matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIN 3.50 at DET 5.31, with a projected total of 8.81. Batter research is strongest for Kody Clemens, Gleyber Torres, Josh Bell, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jahmai Jones, Matt Vierling because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
